title: clausena dentata var. nana
intro: Clausena dentata var. nana, commonly known as Chinese Lavender, is a compact shrub native to China, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and aromatic foliage. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is used to alleviate stress, anxiety, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Clausena dentata var. nana include sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as limonene, linalool, and geraniol, which have been shown to have a calming influence on the nervous system. The plant's bioactive constituents are responsible for its therapeutic actions, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine and aromatherapy.
